title: The kid and the kickflip
phrase: my kid lands a skateboard trick and I want it to look like a skate video

commands.plan: python3 scripts/shotspeak.py plan --phrase "my kid lands a skateboard trick and I want it to look like a skate video" --subject "a kid on a skateboard" --action "landing a kickflip off a low kerb" --setting "an empty car park on a grey day" --out examples/skate-kickflip

bad.prompt: cinematic skateboarding shot, kid doing an awesome trick, smooth cinematic camera movement, bokeh background, lens flares, hyper realistic, 8k
bad.what_you_get: A teenager in the centre, in slow motion, with a blurred background and flares from no light source. The board does not turn.
tells: Fake creamy bokeh, or everything in focus
Aquarium speed: slow floating camera and slow bodies

plain.prompt: A kid on a skateboard rolls toward a low kerb in an empty car park on a grey day, does a kickflip off the kerb and lands it.
plain.what_you_get: The correct trick, seen from eye height and from far away. The kid is small in the frame. The speed is hard to feel.

skill.plain_words: The camera sits on the floor with a wide lens and looks along the ground. The subject towers.
skill.feel: Scale and power. The subject is bigger than the viewer.
look_makes: An extremely wide lens is very low and very close. The ground rushes past.
Straight lines bend at the edges of the frame.
The light is plain daylight. The camera rides along with the person.
skill.what_you_get: A very wide lens on the ground, next to the kerb. The wheels pass close to the lens. The trick looks fast and high.

decisions.Camera movement: locked: the camera does not move, the action comes to it
decisions.Camera placement: on the floor, 3 m away, the lens level and looking along the ground into the light

skill.prompt_block:
SHOT: Low-angle wide shot. 16:9 frame, 2 to 4 s.
SUBJECT AND ACTION: a kid on a skateboard landing a kickflip off a low kerb, in an empty car park on a grey day.
CAMERA MOVE: locked: the camera does not move, the action comes to it.
CAMERA PLACEMENT: on the floor, 3 m away, the lens level and looking along the ground into the light.
LENS: 18 mm.
LIGHT: flat overcast daylight from a grey sky, soft contact shadows under bodies and objects, muted natural contrast, no sun.
COLOUR: muted earth-tone grade: browns, greys and dull greens, low saturation, soft highlights, worn surfaces.
SPEED: slow motion for this one beat only; real gravity, weight and cloth move truthfully, nothing floats.
LOOK: an extremely wide lens very low and very close to the wheels, the ground rushing past the bottom of the frame, lines bending at the edges, plain daylight.
RULES: State the exact number of people. Screen direction stays the same for the whole shot.
AVOID: not a default eye-level medium shot; nobody looks into the lens; every eyeline goes to a target inside the scene; no slow floating camera drift; the camera is locked or makes one decisive move with a clear end; real gravity and real jump height, nobody floats; no bloom, no haze, no fog, no volumetric god rays; worn real textures with dust, creases and small defects, nothing plastic or perfectly clean.
skill.one_line: A kid on a skateboard landing a kickflip off a low kerb, seen from a locked camera on the floor with an ultra-wide lens, the lens level, looking along the ground into the light; 18 mm lens; flat overcast daylight from a grey sky, soft contact shadows under bodies and objects, muted natural contrast, no sun; muted earth-tone grade: browns, greys and dull greens, low saturation, soft highlights, worn surfaces; slow motion for this one beat only; real gravity, weight and cloth move truthfully, nothing floats; an extremely wide lens very low and very close to the wheels, the ground rushing past the bottom of the frame, lines bending at the edges, plain daylight. Avoid: not a default eye-level medium shot; no soft even glow; one motivated light source with a real dark side; nobody looks into the lens; every eyeline goes to a target inside the scene; no slow floating camera drift; the camera is locked or makes one decisive move with a clear end; real gravity and real jump height, nobody floats; no bloom, no haze, no fog, no volumetric god rays.
skill.image_prompt:
A single still frame from a live-action film, 16:9 frame. A storyboard-grade production mock that shows framing, lens, light and colour.
SUBJECT: a kid on a skateboard landing a kickflip off a low kerb, in an empty car park on a grey day. Generic stand-in figures, not a likeness of any real person.
CAMERA: the camera is on the floor with the lens level: the ground stretches from the bottom edge of the frame to the subject, who is seen from the side against the light, with a lot of floor in the foreground. Camera placement: on the floor, 3 m away, the lens level and looking along the ground into the light.
LENS: 18 mm; ultra-wide lens look: deep perspective, a large foreground, a small far background, strong converging lines.
LIGHT: flat overcast daylight from a grey sky, soft contact shadows under bodies and objects, muted natural contrast, no sun.
COLOUR: muted earth-tone grade: browns, greys and dull greens, low saturation, soft highlights, worn surfaces.
MOMENT: a crisp frame from slow motion: dust, cloth and hair caught sharp in mid-movement.
LOOK: an extremely wide lens very low and very close to the wheels, the ground rushing past the bottom of the frame, lines bending at the edges, plain daylight.
FACES: turned away from the lens, in profile, three-quarter or from behind.
AVOID: not a default eye-level medium shot; nobody looks into the lens; every eyeline goes to a target inside the scene; no bloom, no haze, no fog, no volumetric god rays; matte worn floor, no glossy or wet reflections; worn real textures with dust, creases and small defects, nothing plastic or perfectly clean; no over-saturated HDR look; restrained colour and true blacks; real gravity and real jump height, nobody floats.
One frame only: no collage, no split screen, no text, no captions, no logos, no watermark, no border.
